title: The Forecast in Your Chest
evidence_boundary: Constructed-emotion theory is influential and evidence-based but debated; the script does not claim feelings are imaginary, chosen, or freely controllable.
desired_movement: From treating a feeling as a verdict to examining it as a body-informed prediction.
grounding: Feel the chair, notice the feet, and name what is present before interpreting it.
invitation: When the next strong feeling issues a warning, what is your body forecasting—and what is actually happening outside the window?
risk_mitigations: Validate the feeling as real experience.
Never imply a person chose symptoms.
voice_standard: Liam — warm, sly, brilliant friend at midnight; urgent for the newsroom opening, precise at the science boundary, compassionate at the turn, nearly whispered for the grounding and final invitation.

scenes.text: Anxiety often arrives like breaking news: red banner, urgent music, somebody yelling, “Something is wrong.”
scenes.semantic_anchor: Storm radar spins behind a bright red breaking-news frame over a city.
scenes.query: weather radar rotating over city skyline breaking news style bright first frame genuine motion

scenes.text: But your body may be sending weather data—not a final verdict.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Rain gauges and wind vanes translate changing conditions.
scenes.query: weather station instruments moving rain gauge wind vane daylight cinematic

scenes.text: A tight chest. Warm skin. A quick pulse. Shallow breath. Pressure is rising somewhere in the system.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Pressure gauges rise beside fabric expanding like breath.
scenes.query: analog pressure gauges needles rise fabric expands contracts breathing macro cinematic

scenes.text: And your brain, being wonderfully dramatic, hates an unlabeled cloud.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An unlabeled storm cloud moves across a blank forecast map.
scenes.query: single storm cloud moving across blank weather map no text cinematic

scenes.text: So it checks memory, context, expectation, and whatever happened the last time the sky looked like this.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Old forecast cards, photographs, and maps move through a sorting machine.
scenes.query: archive cards photographs weather maps moving through sorting machine warm light

scenes.text: Then it publishes a forecast: anxiety.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A broadcast control room pushes one warning tile onto many screens.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, a dim broadcast control room at night where the glowing monitor wall shows a swirling weather system shaped like a human ribcage instead of a map, one warm amber desk lamp, an empty anchor chair silhouetted, out-of-focus control desk in the near foreground, film grain, photoreal magical realism, no text, no words, no letters

scenes.text: Important: the feeling is real and worthy of care. The forecast may still be incomplete.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A real rain-soaked window sits beside an uncertain weather display.
scenes.query: rain on window beside weather monitor uncertain forecast bright interior motion

scenes.text: Emerging science describes one possibility: emotions can be constructed from bodily signals, learned concepts, context, and prediction.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Body signals, context, and learned categories flow into one forecast engine.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, a translucent glass forecasting machine on a dark desk with a glowing heartbeat waveform feeding into it from one side and a soft weather-map projection blooming out the other, cool blue instrument light with warm amber core, out-of-focus brass dial in the near foreground, shallow depth of field, film grain, photoreal, no text, no words

scenes.text: That does not mean you invented the storm, chose the symptoms, or can smile them away like an irritating life coach.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A person walks safely through rain while a storm warning remains overhead.
scenes.query: person walking under umbrella through rain city street warning light overhead motion

scenes.text: It means the label may contain observation and expectation, blended so smoothly they feel like one thing.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Two transparent weather layers merge into one map.
scenes.query: two transparent weather maps slide together observation expectation layers cinematic motion

scenes.text: Consider excitement. Racing heart. Tight stomach. Restless energy. Very similar instruments—completely different weather report.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A roller-coaster climbs while a heart monitor pulses nearby.
scenes.query: empty roller coaster car cresting steep track against bright sky

scenes.text: One forecast says, “Danger is coming.” Another says, “Something important is about to begin.”
scenes.semantic_anchor: The same instrument panel switches between red warning and gold departure lights.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, a single split-flap indicator panel in warm light, its left half flipping to cold red storm symbols and its right half flipping to golden sunrise symbols from the identical readout, macro depth of field with out-of-focus panel edge in the near foreground, film grain, photoreal, no readable text, abstract glowing symbols only

scenes.text: The body supplies conditions. The mind tries to name the season.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Four seasons move across one landscape while instruments keep recording.
scenes.query: time lapse four seasons across same landscape weather instruments moving cinematic

scenes.text: And sometimes yesterday’s hurricane becomes tomorrow’s default forecast, even when today’s window is dry.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Old storm footage projects across a dry, sunlit kitchen window.
scenes.query: old hurricane projection moving across dry bright kitchen window sunlight cinematic

scenes.text: That is how one possibility hardens into climate and starts decorating the whole week.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Storm icons spread across a paper calendar as pages turn.
scenes.query: paper calendar pages turn storm shadows spread across week no readable text

scenes.text: Not because your mind is broken. Because forecasting is supposed to protect you before certainty arrives.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A lighthouse beam sweeps ahead of a ship before rocks appear.
scenes.query: lighthouse beam sweeps ahead of moving ship before rocky coast dawn cinematic

scenes.text: But forecasts are tools. They deserve attention, not automatic obedience or permanent control.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A forecast card sits on the dashboard but does not touch the steering wheel.
scenes.query: weather forecast card on dashboard hands steer car safely daylight motion no readable text

scenes.text: You do not have to suppress the feeling. You can question the caption while respecting the signal.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A caption tile is lifted away while the underlying waveform keeps moving.
scenes.query: hands remove blank caption card while waveform continues moving studio table

scenes.text: Try separating three things before the newsroom starts shouting again: sensation, prediction, and present evidence.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Three trays receive a stone, a forecast card, and a clear photograph.
scenes.query: three trays receive stone forecast card photograph one by one cinematic tabletop motion

scenes.text: “My chest is tight.” Sensation.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A hand rests lightly on a chest as breathing remains unforced.
scenes.query: hand rests lightly on chest natural breathing bright calm room close-up motion

scenes.text: “This conversation will go badly.” Prediction.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Two empty chairs wait before a conversation begins.
scenes.query: two empty chairs in warm room before conversation curtains moving daylight

scenes.text: “I am sitting in a room. The conversation has not started.” Present evidence.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The camera slowly reveals the ordinary room exactly as it is.
scenes.query: slow camera reveal ordinary bright living room clock curtain cup genuine movement

scenes.text: Feel the chair beneath you. Notice your feet. Let one ordinary breath arrive without proving anything.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Feet settle on the floor; steam rises from a mug beside the chair.
scenes.query: feet settle on floor steam rises mug beside chair bright morning room motion

scenes.text: When the next strong feeling issues a warning, what is your body forecasting—and what is actually happening outside the window?
scenes.semantic_anchor: The forecast screen dims while the real window stays open to changing sky.
scenes.query: weather forecast screen dims real open window changing sky daylight cinematic motion
